name: Polskie hity radiowe 🇵🇱
author: Beatify Team
description: Polish pop and rock radio hits, 1972-2016 — with the heart of the collection in the 1990s and 2000s (75 of 92 tracks): Ich Troje, Myslovitz, Wilki, Lady Pank, Kayah, Brodka et al, alongside the older classics that never left Polish radio (Dwa plus Jeden, Maanam, Perfect, Dzem) and a handful of later hits. Sourced from the in-app playlist funnel (#1891); seven tracks already present in Polskie przeboje wszech czasow / Polski Rock were removed as duplicates.
